JobPolicy.Rule: coupon-library qualify splits a coupon's main-order source set into N contiguous blocks run as N independent worker jobs archiving into one archive directory, then one reducer job on the union (decision 61b; qualify/job_split.py): frugal = the fewest jobs whose every job fits the cluster walltime at 2x the measured PCG counts with the preflight-and-margin factor; speed = the N (<= --max-jobs and the user job cap) minimizing the estimated critical path; fixed = FixedJobs. This block is the library default; --job-policy / --fixed-jobs on the command line override it and the run records the policy used (library-qualification.json JobPolicy per coupon)
JobPolicy.Provenance: user decision 60(2) (2026-09-21): the split is user-configurable as a speed / frugality policy rather than a fixed split; the default stays frugal until the user chooses; acceptance: two-edge-8dd4bc70f183 split in 2 vs the single-job acceptance record (matrices equal to roundoff) and the device coupon spatial-3-edge-5d3b5e644745 (225 sources, 29,272 s single-job estimate > the 21,600 s walltime) under speed with MaxJobs 4

ProductionRecipe.Binding: verify_canonical_case_entries.py and run_general_mesh_suite.py (general_mesh_manifest.validate_production_recipe_commands) require the recorded gmsh-build command of every production case to execute each option exactly once at its value - --trace-basis-size-ratio exactly once at 0.5 when the case binds a trace basis and never otherwise (run_gmsh_only_case.py takes the ratio from these options alone, no default) - and mesh_stage_contract.validate_gmsh_build_census requires --prism-tubes true; the tube record (InnerSize = --edge-size = CornerSize, GrowthRatio, TangentialSize = min(--lc-tangent, FarSize) with the census SizeBounds record, NormalSize = --lc-fine, FarSize = --lc-far, FarGrowth, rings, spacing, SectorDegrees = --tube-sector-degrees or its default 30, PyramidHeight = 0.5 x the outermost ring, prisms, pyramids, the decision-40 layer records within GrowthRatio with the decision-41 surface layer at every tube end on the box, size laws with RadialGrowth 1 and ProtectedDistance 2 x NormalSize, the decision-39 volume laws growing with FarGrowth with their achieved shell statistics, band curves at NormalSize spacing with the recorded junction first-layer sizes, the decision-43 CurveSpacing rows of every explicitly 1D-meshed curve within their spacing and the growth cap), the corner grading, the etch footprint, the junction segments, the trace basis sizing (with its minimum-altitude measure, MinimumBasisAltitude and needle counts recomputed from the recorded triangles), the coupon box rule record (CouponBox: radius, bounds, every CAD-subdivision chain with its union length and the recomputed chained-row / extended-chain counts - decision 47) and the per-type quality gates are bound by mesh_stage_contract.validate_gmsh_build_census; the canonical cache key (CanonicalBuildId) does not encode recipe options

Parameters.EdgeSize: 0.25 nm: the tube's innermost ring size and the corner ball's CornerSize (one graded law)
Parameters.GrowthRatio: 2: ring ratio of the tube cross-section and of the corner shells
Parameters.TubeRings: largest K with r_K + h_K <= min(Overetch, MetalThickness / 2, CornerIsotropyRadius) (7 rings, radius 31.75 nm on the four/ten-edge process)
Parameters.TubeExtrusionSpacing: <= TangentialSize (0.05 um); the layer thickness follows the composed size field on the tube axis (decision 40: min of TangentialSize, the semantic-corner ball law, the trace-basis volume rule, the band rule and the corner-exterior rule; gradient-limited to (GrowthRatio - 1) / GrowthRatio, layers equidistributed in 1 / size, consecutive layers within GrowthRatio; at a tube end on the outer box the end layer is the field at the surface, at most the prescribed size there - decision 41; census PrismTubes.LayerRule / TubeAxisSizeLaw / LayerGrowthCap, LayerThickness.LayersBelowTangentialSizeOverGrowthRatio, per-tube Tubes[].LayerThickness with EndsOnBox; the largest layer is the recorded per-tube Spacing)
Parameters.TubeSectorDegrees: 30 (--tube-sector-degrees, mesher default; the census Section.SectorDegrees must equal the option or its default)
Parameters.TubePyramidHeight: 0.5 x outermost ring size (PyramidHeightOverOuterRing 0.5, mesher constant TUBE_PYRAMID_HEIGHT_OVER_OUTER_RING; the census PyramidHeight must equal 0.5 x the outermost RingSize)
Parameters.TubeCornerClearance: R / tan(phi / 2) + h_K before a semantic corner; the cap centre is a graded point of the corner law
Parameters.NormalSize: 0.25 x MetalThickness (--lc-fine); the size at the tube surface and on the feature-curve bands
Parameters.TangentialSize: 0.05 um (--lc-tangent): extrusion spacing and ridge grid, bounded by the coupon-scale FarSize - TangentialSize = min(--lc-tangent, FarSize) (mesher SIZE_BOUND_RULE; census SizeBounds with RequestedTangentialSize / FarSize / TangentialSize / TangentialSizeBoundByFarSize, bound by mesh_stage_contract.validate_size_bounds): FarSize = FarSizeOverRadius x Radius is the coarsest size the coupon admits (its matching-surface size), so the along-edge tube spacing never exceeds it; dimensionless (the bound acts exactly when Radius < --lc-tangent / FarSizeOverRadius = 0.625 um, i.e. the Radius-0.5 synthetic coupons at FarSize 0.04) and the identity for every production coupon (Radius 2: FarSize 0.16). The resolution sizes NormalSize and EdgeSize = CornerSize are never bounded (a fine size above FarSize fails closed)
Parameters.FarGrowth: 0.5: growth of the tube band and of the feature-curve bands beyond ProtectedDistance = 2 x NormalSize
Parameters.RadialGrowth: 1.0: growth of the feature-curve band inside ProtectedDistance (mesher constant BAND_RADIAL_GROWTH; census SizeLaws.RadialGrowth)
Parameters.ProtectedDistance: 2 x NormalSize (mesher constant BAND_PROTECTED_DISTANCE_OVER_NORMAL; census SizeLaws.ProtectedDistance)
Parameters.TraceBasisVolumeGrowth: = FarGrowth (decision 39a): the trace rule is a volume law, size <= TraceBasisSizeRatio x the minimum altitude of the local basis triangle (decision 43) + FarGrowth x the distance to the basis triangle (census TraceBasisSizing.GradingSlope and SizeLaws.TraceBasisVolumeGrowth; achieved shells in SizeLaws.Achieved.TraceApexes)
Parameters.CornerExteriorGrowth: = FarGrowth (decision 39b): outside a corner ball the size is NormalSize + FarGrowth x the distance beyond CornerIsotropyRadius from the nearest graded point (census SizeLaws.CornerExteriorGrowth / CornerExteriorRule; achieved shells in SizeLaws.Achieved.CornerExterior)
Parameters.JunctionVolumeLaw: the band law (NormalSize + RadialGrowth x min(r, ProtectedDistance) + FarGrowth beyond) on the junction lines throughout the volume (decision 39c; census SizeLaws.JunctionVolumeRule; achieved shells in SizeLaws.Achieved.JunctionLines)
Parameters.BandCurveSpacing: NormalSize: the non-metal longitudinal feature curves (junction lines, footprint edges parallel to a metal edge) are 1D-meshed at the band law's size on the line (census BandCurves.Spacing; achieved first-layer transverse sizes in Bands.JunctionFirstLayer, report only); since decision 43 every explicitly 1D-meshed curve (band curves at NormalSize, un-tubed metal ridge parts at TangentialSize) follows min(its spacing, the composed size field along the curve: corner law, trace rule, band rule, corner exterior rule), gradient-limited within GrowthRatio as the tube axes are (decision 40) - per-curve node spacing and achieved-over-prescribed statistics in census CurveSpacing, bound by validate_gmsh_build_census
Parameters.TraceBasisSizeMeasure: minimum altitude of the basis triangle = 2 x area / longest edge = 1 / the largest gradient of its three vertex hats (decision 43; census TraceBasisSizing.SizeMeasure / MinimumBasisAltitude / MinimumRequestedSize = Ratio x it, bound by validate_gmsh_build_census): the Dirichlet datum the mesh must resolve varies at 1 / altitude; the shortest edge (the measure before decision 43) equals it for right slivers, where the ratio 0.5 was calibrated, and overstates it for needles (case 06: two 0.05 x 8.7 um needles with an 11.3 nm altitude behind a 49.8 nm shortest edge gave E +8% / SA -10% at their four apex sources under the shortest-edge measure). Needle triangles (altitude < 0.6 x shortest edge, report-only census NeedleTriangles / NeedleTrianglesBelowFarSize) are a property of the reference basis triangulation, not of the coupon mesh
Parameters.TraceBasisSizeRatio: 0.5 (--trace-basis-size-ratio, decision 42; 1.0 before): cut-surface and volume trace law at half the local bound-basis hat scale (size <= 0.5 x the minimum altitude of the nearest basis triangle + FarGrowth x the distance to it; the measure was the shortest edge until decision 43, identical for the right slivers the ratio was calibrated on); dimensionless and contract-derived; calibrated by physics-11 (V-a) against physics-10 (ratio 1.0) and physics-12 (V-b TangentialSize 25 nm, rejected): E 60/60 within 1%, p_SA within 1/2/5% 35/44/58, p_MS median -0.60% worst -1.70%, p_MA converged (+0.76%), 0.508 node-h per coupon
Parameters.CouponBox: the coupon box follows the signature rows: a row is extended by 2 x Radius at an end reaching Radius from its reference point (vertex arms at their far end); since decision 47 collinear touching rows of one metal edge (same slot, conductor, plane, tangent, gap; no vertex arm) form a chain judged on its union interval about its midpoint, so the source CAD's subdivision of a straight edge never changes the box (mesher COUPON_BOX_RULE; census CouponBox with EdgeChains, bound by mesh_stage_contract.validate_coupon_box); inert on every registered real case (no touching chain; the 2026-09-19 probe: ten-edge's 4 and six-edge's 2 collinear row pairs are separated by slots)

DesignGate.Rule: the achieved-anisotropy design gate (Gates.MinimumAchievedAspect / Gates.MaximumNormalFactor, unchanged) is replaced under the Gmsh-only pipeline by the prism tube design statement (general_mesh_audit_producer.TUBE_DESIGN_GATE; general_mesh_manifest.tube_design_statement): the recorded rings and extrusion are the design, the audit counts the mesh's prisms and pyramids against the census (CensusMatchesMesh), never gated; the physical gates (positive orientation and Jacobian condition for every element type, scaled Jacobian for tetrahedra, corner aspect, protected surfaces, ownership closure, element cap) are unchanged
DesignGate.Rationale: a tetrahedral band anisotropy statistic has no meaning next to a prism tube (200:1 prisms by design); the metal-edge resolution is the tube record itself

BuildCostEstimate.Rule: pre-build element estimate (estimate_build_cost.py, headroom gate): the recipe's size laws integrated over the coupon from the frozen inputs alone - far field (box volume / FarSize^3), tube band (NormalSize at the tube surface growing with FarGrowth, per tube length), corner balls and tube caps (graded shells from CornerSize, then the corner exterior law), junction / band curves on the metal-loop-perimeter proxy, and the trace basis (half-space Steiner shell integral of s + FarGrowth x d over every basis triangle with s = TraceBasisSizeRatio x minimum altitude < FarSize: needle altitude sets s, needle length the perimeter) - divided by TetrahedraPerCubicSize, plus the recipe's prisms and pyramids (Layers x (Sectors + 2 Sectors (Rings - 1)) and Layers x Sectors); the estimate must not exceed Gates.MaximumElements or the case fails closed before anything is built

Calibration.Rule: tetrahedra realized by the Gmsh build per unit of the size-field integral, calibrated as the MINIMUM integral / actual-tetrahedra ratio over the verified production roots (so the estimate never falls below any calibrated build: fail-closed direction); the integral / actual ratios of the calibration roots are recorded here and every build root records its estimate next to its census (build-cost-estimate.json)
Calibration.Reference: an equilateral tetrahedron of edge h has volume 0.1179 h^3; Gmsh realizes about 0.22 tetrahedra per h^3 of the prescribed field on these coupons (mean edge above the prescription in the graded regions)
